subject: System Design
title: Video Streaming Architecture
description: A micro-lesson that makes Video Streaming Architecture usable.

hook.text: Netflix streams 4K video to 230 million users worldwide. The architecture behind it is staggering.

buildup.text: Videos are split into small chunks, encoded in multiple bitrates, and distributed to CDN edge servers.

discovery.text: Adaptive bitrate streaming detects your bandwidth and switches quality per chunk — seamlessly.

twist.text: Netflix built its own CDN called Open Connect, placing servers inside ISPs for even faster delivery.

climax.text: Modern video streaming is a masterclass in distributed systems, caching, and adaptive algorithms.

punchline.text: Chunk, encode, distribute, adapt — that's streaming at scale.

quiz.question: What does adaptive bitrate streaming do?
options: Switches video quality per chunk based on bandwidth
Downloads the entire video before playing
